item.text: I’m treating this as an exposure-and-attribution chapter first: the Philippines is not a nuclear-armed state, so the key work is finding any ruler-level existential-risk choices that actually existed in 2022, and separating them from inherited posture and general governance. I’m searching official Philippine, IAEA/UN, and a small amount of independent reporting to see whether Marcos made any material nuclear, treaty, or dual-use decisions in-period.
